تقتصرن (form VIII)
# تَقْتَصِرْنَ (taqtaṣirna) /taq.ta.sˤir.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَصَرَ (iqtaṣara)
# تُقْتَصَرْنَ (tuqtaṣarna) /tuq.ta.sˤar.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَصَرَ (iqtaṣara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
